name: TikTok LIVE
strategic_objective: Real-time connection, Q&A, community building, and deeper engagement with followers.

tone: Unfiltered, responsive, and energetic. Still aligned with brand, but more conversational and improvisational.
copywriting_rules: The Live title and description must clearly state the topic and why viewers should join now. Keep the description short and benefit-focused. During the Live, repeat the main value and CTA often as new viewers join.
Title: topic and benefit. Description: 1–3 lines explaining what will happen and who it is for. Include a single main CTA (follow, visit profile, or ask questions).
Support late joiners and keep the topic clear.
Use pinned comments to restate topic and CTA
Avoid cluttering the screen with overlays
If using text overlays, keep them short and clear
Focus on topic consistency and series tags.
Tag co-hosts or guests in the announcement content.

required_generation_elements: Single primary CTA repeated during the session
Opening hook that explains what viewers gain by staying
hard_constraints: Long silent periods or idle time
